SELECT /*LGVCOM00110.basicUserPopupList*/ em.employee_number ,em.full_name_english AS english_full_name ,em.full_name_local AS local_language_full_name ,em.organization_id ,em.org_name_local AS organization_name ,em.grade_type ,em.gender ,em.fse_yn ,em.email AS mail_addr FROM emp_master em WHERE em.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiary_code}
AND em.employee_number like '%' || UPPER(#{employeeNo}) || '%'
AND UPPER(em.full_name_english) like '%' || UPPER(#{englishFullName}) || '%'
ORDER BY em.employee_number
